products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and art application distributed under open-source terms. The foundation's own site presents the project as community-governed, with development driven by contributors rather than commercial ownership.

On the AI side, the foundation tracks a product called Krita AI, which the site describes as incorporating local AI plugins into the Krita application. The approach is notable for having no cloud dependency, meaning AI features run on the user's own hardware rather than through external services, consistent with the project's open-source and community-governance philosophy.

The held facts show no litigation, no MCP server registrations, and no SEC or patent filings associated with the foundation, which is expected for a nonprofit open-source organization of this kind.
